records.rule: SSH can invoke owning MU operator actions, but actual MI work and result must traverse authenticated XTP / Queue Fabric.
Require authenticated result plus RTO2 committed state and controller durable receipt; a packet ACK is insufficient.
Require authoritative service descriptor, route-peer and operational class; receiver-channel labels cannot substitute.
Append identities and preserve existing commissioning keys; local test keys do not grant federation membership.
Inspect the live QEMU initramfs, not a staged directory, and retain boot/runtime fixes.
Mark fixture-only PASS for sorter code; never label ten-host run accepted without twenty real distinct receipts.
The 8-MU/16-MI minimum reference proves controller semantics; ED209 remains ten MUs/twenty MIs and must be commissioned and qualified as such.
An MU is a first-class estate/control member but is not automatically an execution slot. Only explicitly admitted execution resources enter placement.
Economic advice is non-dispatchable; current Job-to-Node placement/lease and WLU authority are still required.

records.rule: A managed execution endpoint does not become an MI merely by being controlled by an MU. Preserve target generation, provenance and separate placement identity.
